description:
Drinko helps you make better cocktails at home with classic recipes, bartending tutorials, and a smart cabinet to track ingredients.

Explore 140+ classic cocktail recipes and 40+ shots — from a Negroni and Old Fashioned to a Margarita, Daiquiri, Mojito, and Gin Tonic — learn essential bartending techniques, save your favorites, and see what's already in your home bar and spirits cabinet before you shop.

Make it yours: add your own recipes with a photo, turn it into a sticker. Your favorites and settings sync with your iPhone and iPad with iCloud.

Drinko is built for beginners and cocktail enthusiasts who want to mix with more confidence, improve their technique, and stay organized behind the bar.
whatsNew:
See what you can mix tonight: What Can I Make? checks your Cabinet and lists every cocktail it covers, plus twists with a spirit you already own.

New
• What Can I Make? shows every cocktail your Cabinet can make right now
• Twists: cocktails you can make by swapping in a spirit you already own
• Switch What Can I Make? between a list and a grid
• A changelog in Settings shows what's new in every update
• Request a feature right from Settings

Improved
• Your own cocktails now switch units too, and ounces convert to the nearest 5 ml
• Today's cocktail from Siri now includes shots
• Delete buttons now appear in your language
promotionalText: See which cocktails you can make with the bottles you already own. What Can I Make? checks your Cabinet and even suggests twists with another spirit.
